This Act, being deemed of immediate 16 importance, takes effect upon enactment. 17 EXPLANATION 18 The inclusion of this explanation does not constitute agreement with 19 the explanation’s substance by the members of the general assembly. 20 This bill relates to the establishment of a state-based 21 exchange and the creation of a state-based exchange fund. 22 The bill defines “state-based exchange” as a state, federal, 23 or partnership exchange or marketplace operating in the state 24 pursuant to section 1311 of the federal Patient Protection and 25 Affordable Care Act, Pub. L. No. 111-148. 26 The bill requires the commissioner of insurance 27 (commissioner) to develop and submit an application for a 28 state innovation waiver pursuant to Code section 505.18A on or 29 before December 31, 2026. Under the bill, at the direction 30 of the governor, the commissioner shall have the authority to 31 create, establish, implement, administer, or otherwise operate 32 a state-based exchange and, if the application for a state 33 innovation is approved, shall do so in accordance with the 34 approved state innovation waiver.
